products.body:
To celebrate the launch of the new Pokémon Mega Evolution: Delta Reign set, we will be be hosting a Pre-release event that you do not want to miss!

Event Details:

  • Game: Pokémon TCG
  • Date: Wednesday, 28th October 2026
  • Time: Registration closes at 5:45pm , event starts at 6:00pm

Entry Includes:

  • One Delta Reign Build & Battle Box (Includes 4 booster packs)
  • 3 Extra Delta Reign booster packs for all participants at the end of the event!
  • Extra packs for players who go 3-0 (win all their matches)

Format & Structure:

  • Format: Sealed Draft
  • Deck Building: 60 minutes to build a 40-card deck using only the cards from your kit
  • Match Style: Swiss Format
  • Rounds: 30 minutes per round (Best of 1)

Rules:

  • Only cards from your kit may be used (no outside cards)
  • Basic Energy will be provided if needed
  • Players will use 4 prize cards per round

Please Note:
All kits are for in-store play only and will not be shipped.

Quick Notice:

We don't allow outside food and drinks into the venue, however we stock a range of these for cheap and you're more than welcome to pick something up here.

Please use the above link to buy your ticket and get your preregister in now. Not only does this help us out on the day, but it helps us use better prizing and overall run better events!
